entries: Iron Spikes come in bundles of ten. As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can use a blunt object, such as a {@item Light Hammer|SRD52}, to hammer a spike into wood, earth, or a similar material. You can do so to jam a door shut or to then tie a {@item Rope|SRD52} or {@item Chain|SRD52} to the Spike.
